title: Identification of stromal cell proportion-related genes in the breast cancer tumor microenvironment using CorDelSFS feature selection: implications for tumor progression and prognosis.
summary: CorDelSFS and cell-type-specific analyses identify stromal gene networks in breast cancer and associate them with tumor microenvironment and prognosis. This is a specific transcriptomic biological association, not causal mechanism.
